body:
Sounds similar to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/103915 so it may be fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105262 too. Can you try the templates provided in the PR?

| :robot: Android templates for testing |
|:-:|
| [Godot_v4.5-android-no-copy_mono_export_templates.tpz](https://github.com/raulsntos/godot/releases/download/android-nocopy/Godot_v4.5-android-no-copy_mono_export_templates.tpz) |

Hey man.

I've used the template you provided to export the android app and It looks to have resolved the issue. I haven't had a crash on launch since, and I've tested it rather rigorously. I'll download 4.4.1 stable.

Thanks for your time.
